newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE bunkers firm, ice lifts premiums for delivery.
newsitem.headline: NWE bunkers firm, ice lifts premiums for delivery.

text.p: NWE bunkers firmed on Tuesday with higher premiums for delivery due to ice blockages, while Mediterranean bunkers were steady, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST traded in a range of $118/$121 fob, up about $2 from late on Monday. The rises had started as a trading house became a concerted buyer of barges in the morning.

Demand in the ARA region was reasonably healthy, but most enquiries, including one large one, came for Antwerp, Flushing and Amsterdam. Rotterdam-based dealers said they faced difficulty supplying because of ice cover on inland waterways. Only the Rhine and sea passages were clear.
Barge owners demanded $1/$1.50 per tonne risk premiums in addition to the normal transport costs.
Delivered Hamburg prices soared as ice restricted movements. Fuel oil 380 CST was quoted at around $130 fob.
"Ice and tug costs add over $1 (per tonne) to the prices," one dealer said.
Mediterranean prices barely changed. Demand remained lacklustre.
However, shortage of supply lifted Egyptian fuel oil bunkers prices by $4/$5 a tonne.
